results.title: Sri Lanka Dealt Major Blow Ahead Of Second Test Against India As Kusal Mendis, Dinesh Chandimal Ruled Out
results.description: Sri Lanka face a major injury setback ahead of the second Test against India, with Kusal Mendis and Dinesh Chandimal ruled out and Pathum Nissanka doubtful.

results.title: Gujarat CM Patel hosted in US, seeks tech and manufacturing partners
results.description: Gujarat CM Bhupendra Patel visited the US to attract global partnerships in manufacturing and technology. He was hosted at India House and held meetings with Google, Perplexity AI, and Micron to bolster the state's semiconductor and AI sectors.

results.title: Credent Connect N Care IPO listing: Shares debut at a solid 90% premium on NSE SME
results.description: Ashish Kacholia-owned Credent Connect N Care made a stellar debut on the NSE SME on Thursday, 20 August. Credent Connect shares were listed at ₹359.10 on the NSE SME, a premium of 90% over the issue price of ₹189.

results.title: Congress recalls Rajiv Gandhi's youth empowerment on 82nd birthday
results.description: On Rajiv Gandhi's 82nd birth anniversary, Congress leaders led by Jairam Ramesh recalled his key contributions to youth empowerment, including lowering the voting age to 18, education reforms, and pioneering India's IT revolution.

results.title: 394 Entities, 36 Professionals: CBDT launches Nationwide Verification of Suspicious Foreign Remittances
results.description: Income Tax Department has launched a nationwide verification exercise covering 394 entities and 36 professionals after identifying suspicious foreign remittances linked to shell entities, non-filers and alleged bogus transactions. The post 394 Entities, 36 Professionals: CBDT launches Nationwide Verification of Suspicious Foreign Remittances appeared first on SCC Times .
